title: "Configuration reference"

## Configuration layers {#sec-configuration-layers}

The supported entry point is `scripts/run_pmf.jl CONFIG.toml --output=RUN_DIR`.
The facade validates TOML tables, applies safe wrapper defaults, resolves named
keys to `MHD_*` options, sets output paths, and finally applies `[environment]`
overrides. The child process does not inherit unrelated shell `MHD_*` variables.
Read `resolved-environment.toml`, not just your input file, when reviewing a run.
{{< src "src/configuration.jl" "function run_environment" >}}

`--backend=cpu|metal|cuda` overrides the named `run.backend`; use the matching
active project. A conflicting low-level `[environment] MHD_BACKEND` override
comes later, so avoid expressing the same choice in both places.

Unknown sections, named options, and unrecognized low-level option names are
errors. Validation is not a science certification and does not replace review
of units, mode support, or the runner's additional runtime checks.

## Shipped experiments {#sec-examples}

| File | Purpose | Boundary |
|---|---|---|
| `examples/smoke.toml` | `16^3`, four-step MHD plus lattice gravity | Noncosmological, chemistry off |
| `examples/cosmology-smoke.toml` | Small full-physics installation check | Very short redshift interval, not converged |
| `examples/pmf-recombination.toml` | Editable recombination research setup | Requires the validation matrix; not a certified production prescription |
| `examples/convergence-suite.toml` | Serialized grid/timestep cases sharing a base config | Case definition, not measured certification |

## Named tables {#sec-named-tables}

These keys map to the public environment interface. The authoritative mapping
and validation are in `CONFIG_KEYS`.
{{< src "src/configuration.jl" "CONFIG_KEYS" >}}

| Table | Common keys | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `[run]` | `n`, `backend`, `precision`, `steps`, `max_cycles`, `cfl` | Grid, device, numerical budget |
| `[run]` | `reconstruction`, `riemann`, `print_every`, `check_every` | Scheme and log/health cadence |
| `[run]` | `checkpoint_every`, `checkpoint_final`, `resume` | Checkpoint write/resume policy |
| `[cosmology]` | `zstart`, `zend`, `h`, `omega_m`, `omega_b`, `omega_lambda`, `omega_r` | Expansion history |
| `[cosmology]` | `box_ckpc_h`, `max_dln_a` | Physical comoving box in ckpc/h, expansion step cap |
| `[magnetic]` | `initial_condition`, `b0_ng`, `brms_code`, `seed` | IC family, comoving nG or code amplitude |
| `[magnetic]` | `kmin`, `kcut`, `kmax`, `mode_lock_n`, `curl_symbol`, `curl_reference_n` | Band, discrete operator, shared modes |
| `[magnetic]` | `normalization`, `reference_kmax`, `reference_kcut`, `minimum_cells_per_wavelength` | Explicit amplitude band and resolution requirement |
| `[magnetic]` | `fixed_mode_power`, `mode_realization`, `realization_box` | Gaussian/fixed realization and physical hashing |
| `[chemistry]` | `mode`, `helium`, `coupling`, `expansion` | Network and operator split |
| `[chemistry]` | `smoothing`, `smoothing_sigma_cells`, `dt_fraction`, `hydrogen_storage` | Mixing approximation and integration controls |
| `[chemistry]` | `ionized_fast_zmin`, `velocity_unit_cms`, `x_hii_initial`, `x_h2_initial`, `nonlocal_table` | Ionized shortcut, physical conversion, initial abundances, table input |
| `[physics]` | `gravity`, `gas_gravity`, `compton_drag`, `drag_mode`, `photon_response` | Coupled physical model |
| `[physics]` | `fft`, `pressure`, `scaling`, `photon_max_dln_a`, `nonlinear_cfl` | Transforms, thermal normalization, clocks, response caps |
| `[physics]` | `glm_project_every`, `glm_ch_factor`, `particle_max_displacement_cells` | Divergence projection and trajectory controls |
| `[diagnostics]` | `redshifts`, `every`, `adaptive_fraction` | Requested outputs and adaptive histories |
| `[diagnostics]` | `spectrum_bins`, `angle_bins`, `pdf_bins`, `energy_ledger_every` | Estimator resolution and energy sampling |

`n` must be even and at least 8. The facade requires finite `zstart > zend >= 0`,
a positive physical box, and a positive comoving `b0_ng` for cosmological configs.
Some transform paths impose additional size/factorization restrictions.

## Defaults are context-dependent {#sec-defaults}

The facade's short-run defaults differ intentionally from invoking the
extracted runner directly:

| Choice | Facade behavior |
|---|---|
| Device / precision | CPU / Float32 unless specified |
| Grid / fixed-time budget | `n=16`, four steps, `cfl=0.2` |
| Warmup | Zero, including cosmological runs |
| Restart / final checkpoint | Disabled unless requested |
| FFT | `auto`, selected per backend |
| Cosmological pressure / magnetic clock | `pressure="auto"`, `scaling="jedamzik"` |
| Cosmological drag / photons | Full-MHD radiation, `moments_exponential` |
| Cosmological chemistry | Full mixing with helium, centered H storage, expansion on, Strang half-steps |
| Ionized shortcut | Off: `MHD_CHEM_IONIZED_FAST_ZMIN=0` |
| Gaussian smoothing | Eight cells unless configured |
| Nonlinear response CFL | `0.1` for cosmological facade defaults |

The recombination example sets some of these explicitly and can differ from
wrapper defaults, including GLM projection cadence. Inspect the resolved run
before comparing experiments. A smoothing width in **cells** changes physically
when `n` changes; scale it for fixed-physical-width convergence tests.

## Escape hatch {#sec-environment-overrides}

```toml
[environment]
MHD_PK_KMAX = 100.53096491487338
MHD_RADIATION_FREE_STREAM_TOL = 0.0
MHD_PMF_NORMALIZATION_Z = 10000.0
MHD_PMF_HIGH_MODE_LOCK_N = 128
```

These override named mappings and facade defaults. Paths are resolved by the
launched process, so use explicit paths for imported initial states and response
tables. Keep runs launched from the repository root. Numerical options with
special encodings should follow their parser, not a guessed boolean conversion.
`MHD_GRAVITY`, for example, uses `true`/`false`.

Do not enable `terminal` or `hybrid` as an automatic speed optimization.
They require `MHD_ALLOW_UNCERTIFIED_TERMINAL=1` and remain legacy comparisons.
Neither a larger source cadence nor a nonzero free-streaming tolerance is a
free accuracy improvement; validate them against a tighter reference.

## Complete driver option index {#sec-environment-index}

This index is generated from `get(ENV, "MHD_...", ...)` calls in the actual
extracted driver. Each link opens its parsing/default logic in the local source
snapshot. A default can depend on other options; the curated tables above and
the resolved environment describe the public facade.
